summary: build_rules_test.sh with private copies of check_sources.sh, the root Makefile and mk/ laid over its trees, each fault failing the row named for it

argv: mkdir -p ${WORK}/overlay/tools/verify ${WORK}/overlay/mk && cd ${SRC} && for f in tools/verify/check_sources.sh mk/toolchain.mk Makefile mk/images.mk mk/arch.mk; do cp $f ${WORK}/overlay/$f || exit 1; done

faults.name: clean
faults.summary: a clean no longer excused from the cross compiler check

faults.name: grub-target
faults.summary: no rule for the GRUB disk

faults.name: tools-late
faults.summary: the tools' names defined in mk/images.mk after the disk rules that name them

edits.find:
MKMBR           = build/tools/image/mkmbr
MKGPT           = build/tools/image/mkgpt
FATCHAINS       = build/tools/image/fatchains
GRUBEMBED       = build/tools/image/grubembed
STICKCHECK      = build/tools/image/stickcheck
DISK_TOOLS      = $(MKMBR) $(MKGPT) $(FATCHAINS) $(GRUBEMBED) $(CFGCHECK) $(SHA256TOOL)
# The pinned GRUB images and their manifest, which the disk and ISO scripts
# copy and check, so that a regenerated image rebuilds what carries it.
GRUB_FILES      = $(wildcard vendor/grub/*.img) vendor/grub/bootx64.efi \
                  vendor/grub/manifest.txt vendor/grub/verify_grub.sh
MKEXFATFIXTURE  = build/tests/host/mkexfatfixture
# mk/images.mk: the products that are not RAM images.
edits.replace:
MKMBR           = build/tools/image/mkmbr
MKGPT           = build/tools/image/mkgpt
FATCHAINS       = build/tools/image/fatchains
GRUBEMBED       = build/tools/image/grubembed
STICKCHECK      = build/tools/image/stickcheck
